verses.english: Inconstant little houses: now here, now there, again & again, I sought the house-builder. Painful is birth, again & again. House-builder, you’re seen! You will not build a house again. All your rafters are broken, and your gables torn down. Released from restriction, the mind will be blown out right here.

Through the round of many births I roamed without reward, without rest, seeking the house-builder. Painful is birth again & again. House-builder, you’re seen! You will not build a house again. All your rafters broken, the roof plate destroyed, immersed what’s without limits, the mind will diffuse right here
